decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a range of products within the backpack category, excluding accessories like towels or tinder. My consideration set includes a high-end tactical pack (Maxpedition), a technical daypack (KAILAS), a packable lightweight option (ZOMAKE), a hydration-focused pack (Lunidry), and a popular sling bag (MOSISO). I chose the KAILAS 28L because it offers the most versatile feature set for serious hiking, including an internal frame and suspension system, and it is highly regarded by reviewers as a cost-effective alternative to premium brands like Osprey.
